erd-is-the-db.title: The diagram is the database
erd-is-the-db.html: This is the movie domain the guide deployed: entities with ordinary typed attributes, and the relations between them. Deploying it is what created the tables the import fills and the endpoints the console calls — nobody wrote a migration, a schema file or an API.

workspaces.title: The data layer is these files
workspaces.html: These tabs are this app's entire data layer: movies.xsql and actors.xsql, which codegen turns into the typed SDK its pages call. No resolvers, no controllers, no ORM — the model you deployed is already the API.

results.title: The exact call your app makes
results.html: Whatever just ran is the identical /data call the page behind you makes — no separate API, no mock data. A write here repaints the pages watching it exactly like your rating did.
